notes.title: SURPRISE CAT - UPDATE
notes.content:
[u][h2][b]What is new?[/b][/h2][/u]
[list]

[*] Fixing bugs
Fixed minor bugs for a better experience for new players.

[*] Auto  restart level
The game will automatically restart when there are no resources left to eliminate the enemies.

[/list]

[h2][b]Thank you for playing![/b][/h2]

notes.title: Surprise Cat is now available!
notes.content: Challenge your mind with the release of our 3D puzzle game! Get ready to dive into a world full of challenging puzzles and intriguing twists. Explore incredible environments, manipulate objects, and uncover hidden secrets as you test your skill and creativity. With stunning visuals and engaging gameplay, this game will captivate your imagination and provide hours of intriguing entertainment. Don't waste any time, embark on this brain-teasing adventure and showcase your puzzle-solving abilities!
